description_en: Queries information about one or more tasks in the recycle bin
description_zh: 查询回收站中的一个或多个任务信息
name: ListRecycleBinJobs

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的行数。

取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the current page in a paged query.

Start value (default value): 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时当前的页码。

起始值（默认值）：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Defragmenting: Data is being defragmented.
PartialSuccess: The task partially succeeded.
Success: The task succeeded.
Fail: The task failed.
Cancelled: The task is canceled.
All (default): All statuses
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态。取值：

Running：运行中
Defragmenting：数据整理中
PartialSuccess：部分运行成功
Success：运行成功
Fail：运行失败
Cancelled：已取消
All（默认值）：全部
parameters.name: status

Jobs.description_en: The collection of task information in the recycle bin
Jobs.description_zh: 回收站中的任务信息集合

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间。按照 ISO 8601 标准表示，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This value is valid only when Status is Fail or PartialSuccess
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当Status为Fail或PartialSuccess时，该返回值有效

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

This value is valid only when JobStatus is Fail or PartialSuccess
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

当JobStatus为Fail或PartialSuccess时，该返回值有效
ErrorMessage.example: The Target File or Directory does not exist.

FileId.description_en: The FileId of the file or directory associated with the task
FileId.description_zh: 任务对应文件或目录的FileId

FileName.description_en: The name of the file or directory associated with the task
FileName.description_zh: 任务对应文件或目录的名称

Progress.description_en:
The execution progress of the task.

Valid values: 1 to 100
Progress.description_zh:
查询任务的执行进度。

取值范围：1~100

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Defragmenting: Data is being defragmented.
PartialSuccess: The task partially succeeded.
Success: The task succeeded.
Fail: The task failed.
Cancelled: The task is canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。包括：

Running：运行中
Defragmenting：数据整理中
PartialSuccess：部分运行成功
Success：运行成功
Fail：运行失败
Cancelled：已取消

Type.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:

Restore: A file restoration task.
Delete: A file deletion task
Type.description_zh:
任务类型。包括：

Restore：文件恢复任务
Delete：文件删除任务

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of tasks per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每个分页包含的任务个数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tasks in the recycle bin
TotalCount.description_zh: 回收站中任务的总个数
